replication.target_description: Study 1: 9-month-old infants’ manual choice of the Helper over the Hinderer, two-tailed binomial test against chance; identified from the supplied p.5 locator and outcome, independently of counts.

es.quote: the Helper over the Hinderer puppet (15 infants out of 24, p = .307, binomial test).

notes: Assigned completion scope: es_value_r only; all other fields are unassigned placeholders. Identity independently checked: title, Salvadori/Blazsekova/Volein/Karap/Tatone/Mascaro/Csibra authors, journal/year and DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0140570 match the supplied replication reference. Canonical text is a paginated primary PLOS ONE research article (10 pages), including methods, results and references, rather than an abstract or secondary report. No PDF was supplied. The p.5 locator identifies Study 1 helper-versus-hinderer choice. The primary report prints 15 infants out of 24 and same-test p = .307, binomial test, and states all statistics are two-tailed. It supplies no separately labelled numerical test statistic or effect-size metric for this target. The observed count is retained as evidence rather than relabelled or converted to a test statistic. The nearby color and side tests concern different outcomes and are not substituted; Study 2 is on pp.6–7. No calculation performed.
